title.vi: Chỉ số hiểm họa trên đất trồng trọt

provenance.source: layers dem-dtm, flood-s1-2018, lc-cropfrac, sal-evianom, spi3 (this repository)
provenance.processing: cells with >= 50 % WorldCover 2021 cropland; flood = largest monthly S1 water share Jul-Dec 2018; rain = mean Feb-Apr SPI-3 2016/2020/2024, 0 at >= 0, 100 at <= -2.0 (5 km, nearest); crop = share of 2016/2020/2024 with Feb-Apr EVI anomaly <= -0.05; low = 100 at DeltaDTM <= 1.0 m, 0 at >= 3.0 m, linear
provenance.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; CHIRPS (UCSB CHC); MODIS (NASA LP DAAC); DeltaDTM (Pronk et al. 2024, CC BY 4.0); ESA WorldCover 2021 (CC BY 4.0)
